I added `wrap(text, width)` in `textkit/wrap.py` and the `wrap TEXT [--width N]` command (default width 40). `python3 -m unittest` passes (55 tests), including the new `tests/test_wrap.py`, which covers the function and the CLI command. I didn't run the CLI commands from c3 by hand. The tests cover the same cases, including `wrap x --width 0` exiting 2 with `error:` on stderr.

I also added the `wrap` row to the README "Commands" table and a `wrap` bullet under `## Unreleased` in `CHANGELOG.md`. A test checks that `python3 -m textkit commands` lists `wrap`.

One thing you didn't specify: a non-integer width such as `1.5` or `True` also raises `ValueError`, not just `width < 1`.
